show.description: Star-crossed lovers Dhruv and Nakshatra lead a quiet life as a chef and a florist, each hiding a lethal secret: they are the heirs to rival mafia empires. When a bloody underworld war forces them back into the shadows, they unknowingly become each other’s deadliest targets.
